excluded: complete TCP and general byte/output/timing or implementation refinement proof
SACK/NewReno/ECN and automatic new-data emission on post-third duplicate ACKs
numerically different pre/post exclusion thresholds beyond the finite queue16 capacity

LT-SEND.interpretation: January2001 section2 and RFC5681 September2009 section3.2 step1: each of the first two qualifying duplicate ACKs sends at most one SMSS of queued new data when rwnd allows and FlightSize remains <=cwnd+2SMSS. cwnd MUST NOT grow for these sends. No SACK is negotiated in this finite model.

LT-THRESHOLD.interpretation: Section3.2 step2: exclude actual Limited Transmit bytes of the current no-UNA-advance duplicate epoch from the third-duplicate loss threshold basis. Epoch clears on UNA advance, recovery entry, actual congestion RTO, persist or cleanup. Record the basis explicitly even when queue16/SMSS4 makes both numerical thresholds clamp to 8.

LT-SOURCE.interpretation: Official RFC3042/RFC5681 texts, versions and sections bound by raw SHA256.

LT-SCOPE.interpretation: SMSS4/combined queue16, pure accepted non-SACK ACKs. Reuse shared new-data actions, byte timestamps, RTT/Karn and pending ACK cancellation. Existing-flight LT does not restart the RTO deadline. Automatic LT declines an idle interval >current RTO; explicit idle restart remains available. No post-FIN data, SACK/NewReno, general byte/output/timing or implementation proof.
